task.title: Robot and the Lost Cat
task.prompt: A small delivery robot searches for a lost kitten on a rainy neon night.

style_guide.name: Robot and the Lost Cat Style Guide
notes: Keep style consistent across all generated assets.
Prefer clear silhouettes and readable compositions.

planned_assets.title: Main Character Reference
planned_assets.description: A consistent reference sheet for the protagonist and companion.
planned_assets.prompt: Warm cinematic comic illustration character reference sheet, consistent design for the main delivery robot and the lost kitten companion; gentle, hopeful, slightly mysterious mood; amber, cobalt blue, and rainy gray palette; clean readable turnaround-style layout with front, side, and back views of the robot, plus small expression and pose callouts; clear silhouettes, simple shapes, defined materials, and consistent proportions; rain-soaked neon-night story context implied through subtle background accents; legible post-processed labels in English; keep the design friendly and non-horror, with reliable comic styling and strong character consistency across panels.
